name: Pet Food Plant - Topeka KS
type: Manufacturing/Distribution - Pet food plant + distribution center

fieldNotes.location: Roster address was only 'Topeka, KS 66619' with an APPROXIMATE geocode (moved 2646m) landing on south-central Topeka - WRONG location. Web search resolved the real plant to 2200 NW Brickyard Rd, Topeka KS 66618 (Big Heart Pet Brands / J.M. Smucker pet food plant + distribution center, formerly Del Monte). Confirmed coords 39.087119, -95.722563. NOTE: distinct from the nearby Goodyear tire plant at 2000 NW US-24 (the very large multi-section plant ~2km ENE). Building positively identified: large multi-section manufacturing plant joined to a large distribution center, extensive trailer drop yards, ingredient silos along the rail.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Large fenced industrial campus. Internal truck roads and yards are enclosed; truck access comes from the SW via internal roads off NW Brickyard Rd. Street View coverage does not reach the actual truck gate (panos only reach the corporate office building and surrounding rural roads), so the gate type (arm vs sliding gate) is inferred from a fenced campus of this scale - classified true but flagged uncertain. truckGateCount estimated 2.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively identified in available imagery. A large food/DC campus of this scale very commonly has a gatehouse, but none was confirmed - classified false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis of a controlled gate with no confirmed guard booth; low confidence given imagery limits.
fieldNotes.railServed: TRUE - a rail line runs along the south edge of the property with a long row of bulk ingredient silos served directly off the rail. Clear in z19-z20.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is highly likely at a rail-served bulk-ingredient plant + DC of this size; a small pad/structure consistent with a scale appears near the SW entrance area. Classified true, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: TRUE - a campus: a multi-section manufacturing plant, a large attached/adjacent distribution center, plus ancillary buildings (corporate office, warehouse/equipment buildings). Web sources describe a 'pet food plant AND distribution center', ~1.2M sq ft.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: True - bulk ingredient receiving is rail-side (south/west, near the silos); finished-goods shipping runs from the distribution center dock banks on a separate face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - the distribution center alone shows a long dock face with dozens of doors; combined with plant docks the site is well into the 50+ band. Exact count ~60 is an estimate (roof glare on the DC), flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - east-side and central drop yards hold well over 100 parked drop trailers in rows.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal yards easily hold 3+ truck queues between gate and docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Large campus with multiple access points on different faces; per-gate in/out lane counts not determinable - entryLanes/exitLanes flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-Topeka location at a highway interchange, with farmland and a rail corridor immediately around the property. Topeka is a mid-size city but this site sits on its rural NW fringe - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: trailersVisible ~130 and capacity ~180 are honest order-of-magnitude estimates across the multiple drop yards; dockDoorCount ~60 is a rough estimate.
